labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Strict Mode now unmounts and remounts every component on first mount, which can break apps whose components are not resilient to remounting.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: React now always synchronously flushes effects for discrete input updates, a timing change that can alter existing behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Hydration text mismatches are now errors instead of warnings and cause client re-rendering up to the nearest Suspense boundary, a behavior change that can break hydrated apps.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Components that suspend are now discarded and re-rendered from scratch, a behavior change for suspending trees.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Layout effects are now cleaned up and re-created when a boundary reverts to fallback, changing effect lifecycle behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: React now requires modern browser features such as Promise, Symbol, and Object.assign, so older browsers like Internet Explorer need polyfills.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The unstable scheduler/tracing API is removed, so any code using it will break.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Components may now return undefined without throwing, which is a relaxation that requires no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Act warnings in tests are now opt-in rather than default, changing test behavior for users who relied on them.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The setState-on-unmounted warning is removed, which requires no user action and does not break correct code.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Console logs for the second Strict Mode render are no longer suppressed by default, changing default log output that may confuse existing workflows.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: React cleans up more internal fields on unmount, a improvement that needs no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: renderToString no longer errors on server suspension and instead emits fallback HTML, changing server rendering behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: renderToStaticMarkup no longer errors on server suspension and instead emits fallback HTML, changing server rendering behavior.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: useTransition and useDeferredValue are new additive APIs that require no migration.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: useId is a purely additive new hook for generating unique IDs.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: useSyncExternalStore is a purely additive new hook for external store integration.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: startTransition is a new additive API that requires no user action.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: useInsertionEffect is a purely additive new hook for CSS-in-JS libraries.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Layout effects are now remounted when Suspense content reappears, a lifecycle behavior change that can affect existing components.
